_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Umbrava-wire <-> canonical-df field vocabulary. This file is CANONICAL here (the api/* routes require it at runtime); a byte-identical mirror lives at userscripts/scripts/field-map.json (test-time only - the TM producer cannot require a file in the browser). Edit BOTH or they drift (same rule as the caveman skill mirror). Derived 2026-08-13 from the four prior restatements it replaces: Core heatDatasetRows (producer), api/wo-ingest jobFacts allowlist, api/dataset-ingest STR/DATE/NUM_MAP, agent.html WO_ALIASES. Adding a field = edit this file, then the conformance test each side fails until both carry it. INVARIANTS the tests enforce: every fields[].canonical is a WO_ALIASES key in agent.html; every enrichmentOnly column is too; the live route maps are a subset of fields[] with matching canonical; every wire key a producer emits is declared with that producer tagged.

per-job docs-present count; Core writes bwn:docs:<wo> from readDocs() (confident reads only - unknown stays absent, never 0), pushJobFacts carries it. Track A docs-closure slice.

Track A trips/no-show slice: earliest scheduled trip whose onsite date passed with NO clock-in (jobIVRs). Core computes it into bwn:trips:<wo> (fetchTrips); pushJobFacts carries days-since. Absent = no active no-show. 12h TTL on the read.
vendor of the no-show trip (pairs with noShowDays); from bwn:trips:<wo>.noShow.vendor.

Track A proposals+GP: the real API GP% Core computes (trueGrossProfitPercent else estimatedGrossProfitPercent * 100), published on the bwn:wo bus; AI reads the bus. UNTAXED basis (same as the dashboard's own estimate); the taxed chip basis needs per-location tax rate. gpCellHtml prefers this over its DNE-minus-NTE estimate.

Track A proposals+GP: count of client proposals with NO terminal date (approved/rejected/canceled). Core fetchProposals -> bwn:props:<wo> (confident reads only - unknown stays absent, never a guessed 0).
Track A notes-history: total notes on the WO, from Core's bwn:wo bus (state.noteCount). AI reads the bus. Note volume beyond the board's lastNoteDate staleness.
Track A notes-history: days since the newest CLIENT-typed note (bus lastClientNote). Client silence specifically - distinct from the board's any-note lastNoteDate. Absent = no client note loaded.

Track A tasks: count of INCOMPLETE tasks on the WO. Core fetchTasks (API, entityType 1 / entityId=WO number) -> bwn:tasks:<wo> (confident only). Replaces the fragile DOM 'Open Tasks N' scrape for the ingest. Query pinned-schema, NOT live-verified.

enrichmentOnly._comment: Canonical df columns that ride the DAILY UPLOAD path only (human/agent-entered or agent-computed). No wire producer; Track A does NOT source these. Listed so a conformance test knows they are intentionally producer-less, not orphans.
